data.title: 瑕光 · 刚烤好的面包
data.description: 她从店里出来，纸袋里装着刚烤好的面包。热气透过袋口冒出来，她提议先分一块尝尝。
data.promptProse: Stepping out from a cozy artisan bakery in early morning, Blemishine beams brightly while clutching a warm brown paper bag filled with crusty baguettes. Golden dawn light washes over the cobblestone street, illuminating glass bakery displays of fruit tarts and pastries, while mouthwatering steam wafts into the crisp morning air.
data.animaCaption: Pausing outside a cobblestone artisan bakery at dawn, she cradles a brown paper bag of steaming crusty bread in both hands with a beaming smile. Golden morning light catches the rising vapor and pastry displays behind her.
